"Build a 3D platformer game with beautiful, high-quality graphics using Three.js (WebGL) in the browser, ready to run with minimal setup (a single index.html plus CDN imports is fine).

CONCEPT
- Third-person 3D platformer with a stylized, lush, vibrant world (inspired by Astro Bot, Ratchet @COMMENT_BODY@ Clank, and Genshin Impact's visual quality).
- One large, connected open world split into themed zones (e.g., sunlit meadow, ancient ruins, crystal caves, floating islands) with NO \"level complete\" screen. Zones connect through gates, bridges, and portals.
- Collectibles (gems/orbs), checkpoints, and moving or hazardous platforms.
- A boss at the end of each zone, unlocking the next area.

CONTROLS (highly responsive, zero perceived input lag)
- Move relative to the camera, jump (hold for higher), double jump, dash, melee attack, wall slide/jump, and ledge grab.
- Mobile touch: virtual analog joystick on the left, action buttons on the right (Jump, Dash, Attack), with MULTI-TOUCH so the stick and buttons work simultaneously.
- Also support gamepad (Gamepad API) and keyboard + mouse.
- Control feel: fixed-timestep physics, coyote time, jump buffering, input buffering, smooth acceleration/deceleration, and a collision-safe character controller (no clipping through walls or floors).
- Smooth third-person camera with collision avoidance, orbit control, and lock-on for combat.

GRAPHICS (top priority)
- PBR materials (MeshStandardMaterial/MeshPhysicalMaterial) with normal, roughness, and ambient occlusion maps where possible.
- HDR environment lighting (image-based lighting), a dynamic sun with high-resolution cascaded or soft shadow maps, and a procedural sky with day/night or time-of-day cycle.
- Post-processing via EffectComposer: bloom, SSAO, subtle depth of field, color grading/tone mapping (ACES Filmic), vignette, and anti-aliasing (SMAA/FXAA).
- Volumetric-style fog, god rays, and atmospheric depth.
- Animated water with reflections and refraction, wind-swayed grass and trees (instanced for performance), particle effects (dust, fireflies, sparkles, dash trails).
- Skeletal character animation (idle, run, jump, fall, land, dash, attack) with smooth blending. If no model is available, use a placeholder stylized character built from primitives and clearly mark where to swap in a GLTF model.
- Load assets via GLTFLoader with Draco/KTX2 compression support.

PERFORMANCE
- Instancing, frustum culling, LOD, and texture compression.
- Graphics quality settings menu: Low / Medium / High / Ultra, which toggle shadows resolution, post-processing, and render scale.
- Target 60 FPS on mid-range devices; auto-adjust resolution scale if FPS drops.

COMBAT @COMMENT_BODY@ GAMEPLAY
- Basic combos with hit-stop, knockback, and camera shake.
- At least 3 enemy types with distinct AI (patrol, chase, ranged).
- At least 1 boss with multiple phases and a health bar.
- Player HP, damage invincibility frames, and respawn at last checkpoint.

AUDIO
- WebAudio sound effects for jump, land, dash, attack, and collectibles, plus ambient background music loop.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Clean, modular code (Player, Camera, Input, World, Enemy, Boss, Effects, UI) with clear comments.
- Main menu, pause menu, settings (graphics, controls), and Game Over screen.
- Save progress with localStorage.

WORKFLOW
Work in stages. Stage 1: renderer setup with the full graphics pipeline + a beautiful small test environment + player controller with all controls. After that, propose next stages (world zones, enemies, boss, collectibles, UI, audio). Do NOT move on to the next stage until I say OK.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

    align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 22px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, #123b44, #071219 58%, #03080c 100%);
    transition: opacity .8s ease, visibility .8s;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
  #loading.hidden { opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; }
  .load-mark { width: 92px; height: 92px; position: relative; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(128, 245, 232, .55)); }
  .load-mark svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; animation: spinSlow 9s linear infinite; }
  .load-mark::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, #d8fff9, #51e3d8 38%, #0b5f66 75%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 26px #63efe0;
    animation: pulseGlow 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes spinSlow { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  @keyframes pulseGlow { 0%,100% { transform: scale(.92); opacity: .85; } 50% { transform: scale(1.06); opacity: 1; } }
  .load-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: .38em; color: var(--gold); text-transform: uppercase; }
  .load-bar { width: min(340px, 66vw); height: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
  .load-bar > i { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0%; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3fdacb, #ffe29a); box-shadow: 0 0 16px #71efe3; transition: width .3s ease; }
  .load-tip { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

  /* ---------- main menu ---------- */
  #menu { justify-content: flex-start; background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(2, 10, 14, .9) 0%, rgba(3, 15, 21, .6) 38%, rgba(2, 9, 13, .05) 72%, rgba(2, 8, 11, .25) 100%); backdrop-filter: blur(0px); }
  .menu-inner {
    margin-left: clamp(22px, 7vw, 110px); width: min(560px, 86vw);
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 30px; padding: 30px 0;
    animation: menuRise .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  }
  @keyframes menuRise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  .brand-kicker { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .42em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cyan); opacity: .9; }
  .brand-kicker::before { content: ""; width: 38px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--cyan)); }
  .brand-title {
    font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(46px, 7.4vw, 98px); line-height: .94; letter-spacing: .02em;
    background: linear-gradient(168deg, #fff7dc 8%, #ffe1a0 35%, #e9b257 62%, #8ff7ec 130%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 38px rgba(255, 202, 112, .18));
  }
  .brand-sub { display: block; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: clamp(12px, 1.4vw, 16px); letter-spacing: .5em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #d7ece9; margin-top: 12px; opacity: .76; }
  .brand-line { height: 1px; width: 72%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,216,138,.7), rgba(255,216,138,0)); margin-top: 2px; }
  .brand-desc { color: #b8d0d2; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 440px; font-weight: 300; }
  .menu-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 11px; width: min(330px, 100%); margin-top: 4px; }

  .btn {
    position: relative; pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--glass-line);
    background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(17, 48, 58, .72), rgba(7, 23, 31, .55));
    color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 500;
    padding: 14px 22px; border-radius: 10px; text-align: left;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px;
    letter-spacing: .06em; font-size: 14px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    transition: transform .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, background .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .btn::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--cyan), transparent); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s; }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateX(5px); border-color: rgba(143,247,236,.42); background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(25, 72, 80, .8), rgba(9, 31, 40, .68)); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.28); }
  .btn:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
  .btn.primary { background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255, 214, 130, .16), rgba(15, 46, 52, .8) 60%); border-color: rgba(255, 218, 144, .38); }
  .btn.primary .btn-label { color: var(--gold); }
  .btn-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .btn-key { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .16em; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; }
  .btn-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; opacity: .9; }
  .btn-arrow { color: var(--cyan); opacity: .65; font-size: 16px; transition: transform .2s, opacity .2s; }
  .btn:hover .btn-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); opacity: 1; }
  .btn:disabled { opacity: .36; cursor: default; transform: none; }

  .menu-footer { display: flex; gap: 20px; align-items: center; color: #6e8b90; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .menu-footer b { color: #b9d6d5; font-weight: 500; }
  .menu-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(160,240,235,.16); border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(8,26,32,.4); }
  .menu-badge .dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #7df4e6; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #7df4e6; }

  /* ---------- generic panel ---------- */
  .panel {
    position: relative; width: min(760px, 92vw); max-height: min(86vh, 780px); overflow: auto;
    background: linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(11, 34, 42, .94), rgba(4, 15, 21, .96));
    border: 1px solid rgba(159, 240, 233, .16); border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 34px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    padding: 30px clamp(20px, 4vw, 42px) 32px;
    animation: panelRise .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  }
  @keyframes panelRise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px) scale(.985); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  .panel::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,218,144,.45), transparent); }
  .panel-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .panel-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: .12em; color: #fff5da; margin: 0; }
  .panel-kicker { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .3em; color: var(--cyan); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .icon-btn {
    width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(156,236,230,.22);
    background: rgba(9, 29, 36, .7); color: #cfeceb; cursor: pointer; font-size: 20px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: .2s;
  }
  .icon-btn:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold); transform: rotate(90deg); }

  .settings-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px 30px; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) { .settings-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .setting { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.055); }
  .setting-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
  .setting-name { font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .05em; color: #dcedec; }
  .setting-value { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--gold); text-transform: uppercase; }
  .setting-hint { font-size: 11px; color: #6f8c90; line-height: 1.5; }
  .seg { display: flex; background: rgba(2, 11, 15, .6); border: 1px solid rgba(160,240,235,.13); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px; gap: 3px; }
  .seg button {
    flex: 1; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #8da8ab; padding: 7px 8px; border-radius: 6px;
    font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer;
    transition: .16s;
  }
  .seg button:hover { color: #dff7f4; }
  .seg button.active { background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255,216,140,.19), rgba(70,208,198,.14)); color: var(--gold); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,216,140,.18); }
  input[type=range] { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.13); border-radius: 4px; outline: none; }
  input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,216,140,.5); cursor: pointer; }
  .toggle { width: 40px; height: 22px; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: .2s; flex: none; }
  .toggle::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9bb1b3; transition: .2s; }
  .toggle.on { background: rgba(68, 218, 203, .35); border-color: rgba(111,245,232,.4); }
  .toggle.on::after { left: 21px; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan); }

  .help-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  @media (max-width: 720px) { .help-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .help-card { background: rgba(4, 17, 22, .5); border: 1px solid rgba(160,240,235,.1); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 18px; }
  .help-card h4 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .22em; color: var(--cyan); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; }
  .key-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.055); font-size: 12px; color: #bed3d3; }
  .key-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .keys { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; }
  kbd { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 10px; min-width: 22px; text-align: center; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16); border-bottom-width: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); color: #e8f7f5; }
  .help-note { margin-top: 16px; color: #77979a; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: .02em; }

  .big-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 26px; }
  .big-actions .btn { flex: 1 1 160px; justify-content: center; }

  /* ---------- HUD ---------- */
  #hud { position: fixed; inset: 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .4s; pointer-events: none; }
  #hud.visible { opacity: 1; }
  .hud-top-left { position: absolute; top: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); left: calc(22px + var(--safe-l)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  .hearts { display: flex; gap: 5px; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)); }
  .heart { width: 24px; height: 22px; transition: transform .2s, opacity .2s; }
  .heart svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  .heart.full path { fill: #ff6d8f; }
  .heart.empty path { fill: rgba(255,255,255,.12); stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.2); stroke-width: .7; }
  .heart.pop { animation: heartPop .35s cubic-bezier(.2,1.7,.4,1); }
  @keyframes heartPop { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.35); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }
  .hud-chip {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: fit-content;
    padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(150,230,225,.14);
    background: rgba(4, 18, 24, .52); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; color: #c9e4e2; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .hud-chip .gem-ico { width: 14px; height: 14px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #6ff3e7); }
  .hud-chip b { color: #fff3d6; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; }

  .hud-top-center { position: absolute; top: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; width: min(440px, 60vw); }
  .zone-label { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .34em; color: rgba(255, 244, 218, .9); text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }
  .objective { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9fbfc2; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
  .objective .obj-diamond { width: 6px; height: 6px; transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold); animation: objPulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes objPulse { 0%,100% { opacity: .45; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(.8); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1.15); } }

  .hud-top-right { position: absolute; top: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); right: calc(22px + var(--safe-r)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; }
  .compass { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(160, 240, 235, .22); background: rgba(4,18,24,.42); position: relative; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); transition: opacity .3s; }
  .compass.hidden { opacity: 0; }
  .compass::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(160,240,235,.12); border-radius: 50%; }
  .compass-arrow { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 0; height: 0; transform-origin: 50% 50%; transition: transform .12s linear; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,216,140,.8)); }
  .compass-arrow::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -5px; top: -13px; border-left: 5px solid transparent; border-right: 5px solid transparent; border-bottom: 12px solid var(--gold); }
  .compass .compass-dist { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -13px; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #91aaad; white-space: nowrap; }

  .dash-meter { position: absolute; bottom: calc(26px + var(--safe-b)); left: calc(26px + var(--safe-l)); width: 82px; height: 82px; opacity: .9; }
  @media (max-width: 820px) { .dash-meter { display: none; } }
  .dash-meter svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; transform: rotate(-90deg); overflow: visible; }
  .dash-meter .track { fill: none; stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.09); stroke-width: 3; }
  .dash-meter .fill { fill: none; stroke: url(#dashGrad); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke-dashoffset .1s linear; }
  .dash-meter .label { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .18em; color: #9ebdbf; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .dash-meter .label b { font-size: 12px; color: #d9f4f0; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; }

  .combo-pop { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 25%; transform: translate(-50%, -10px) scale(.9); font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 30px; color: var(--gold); text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255,200,100,.5); opacity: 0; transition: .18s; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  .combo-pop.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0) scale(1); }

  #bossbar { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(42px + var(--safe-b)); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(16px); width: min(620px, 72vw); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .4s, transform .4s; pointer-events: none; z-index: 12; }
  #bossbar.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
  .boss-meta { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 7px; }
  .boss-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffe9c0; text-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.8); }
  .boss-phase { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .2em; color: #c3a276; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .boss-track { height: 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(3,10,14,.78); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 220, 160, .22); overflow: hidden; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
  .boss-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a73e46, #ff7b66 45%, #ffd38c); transition: width .25s ease; box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255,120,90,.5); position: relative; }
  .boss-fill::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.35), transparent 62%); }
  .boss-ticks { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-evenly; }
  .boss-ticks i { width: 1px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.4); }

  /* ---------- toasts / zone card / interact ---------- */
  #toasts { position: fixed; top: calc(86px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; z-index: 30; pointer-events: none; }
  .toast {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 30px;
    background: rgba(5, 22, 28, .78); border: 1px solid rgba(160,240,235,.18); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #d9f4f1;
    animation: toastIn .45s cubic-bezier(.2,1.3,.4,1), toastOut .5s 2.7s forwards; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  }
  .toast .t-ico { font-size: 14px; color: var(--gold); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,216,140,.7)); }
  @keyframes toastIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px) scale(.94); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  @keyframes toastOut { to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(.97); } }

  #zonecard { position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 39%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); text-align: center; z-index: 28; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; }
  #zonecard.show { animation: zoneShow 4.2s ease forwards; }
  #zonecard .zc-kicker { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .5em; color: var(--cyan); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; opacity: .8; }
  #zonecard .zc-name { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(30px, 5vw, 62px); letter-spacing: .12em; color: #fff6dd; text-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(255,210,120,.35), 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.6); white-space: nowrap; }
  #zonecard .zc-line { width: 90px; height: 1px; margin: 15px auto 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,216,140,.8), transparent); }
  #zonecard .zc-sub { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .3em; color: #a9c4c4; text-transform: uppercase; }
  @keyframes zoneShow {
    0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -46%) scale(.98); filter: blur(6px); }
    12% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); filter: blur(0); }
    75% { opacity: 1; }
    100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -53%); }
  }

  #interact { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 22%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); z-index: 24; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 30px; background: rgba(4,18,24,.72); border: 1px solid rgba(255,220,160,.3); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .16em; color: #ffe9c1; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0; transition: .25s; pointer-events: none; }
  #interact.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
  #interact kbd { margin-right: 8px; }

  #reticle { position: fixed; width: 26px; height: 26px; margin: -13px 0 0 -13px; z-index: 22; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,210,130,.7)); }
  #reticle.visible { opacity: 1; }
  #reticle::before, #reticle::after { content: ""; position: absolute; background: rgba(255, 224, 158, .9); }
  #reticle::before { left: 50%; top: 0; width: 1px; height: 8px; box-shadow: 0 18px 0 rgba(255,224,158,.9); }
  #reticle::after { top: 50%; left: 0; height: 1px; width: 8px; box-shadow: 18px 0 0 rgba(255,224,158,.9); }

  #damage-vignette { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 20; opacity: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 42%, rgba(255, 30, 60, .42) 100%); transition: opacity .25s; }
  #damage-vignette.flash { animation: dmgFlash .55s ease-out; }
  @keyframes dmgFlash { 0% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
  #heal-vignette { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 20; opacity: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 48%, rgba(80, 255, 210, .22) 100%); }
  #heal-vignette.flash { animation: dmgFlash .8s ease-out; }

  #fade { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: #020a0e; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 60; transition: opacity .5s ease; }
  #fade.black { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

  #lockhint { position: fixed; bottom: calc(30px + var(--safe-b)); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .22em; color: rgba(190,220,220,.4); text-transform: uppercase; z-index: 12; pointer-events: none; }

  /* ---------- touch controls ---------- */
  #touch { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 16; pointer-events: none; display: none; }
  body.touch-mode #touch { display: block; }
  #touch .stick-zone {
    position: absolute; left: calc(22px + var(--safe-l)); bottom: calc(24px + var(--safe-b));
    width: 150px; height: 150px; pointer-events: auto; touch-action: none;
  }
  .stick-base {
    position: absolute; inset: 18px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(163, 240, 233, .22);
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(8, 30, 37, .3), rgba(4, 17, 22, .5)); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  }
  .stick-knob {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 54px; height: 54px; margin: -27px 0 0 -27px; border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(153, 247, 237, .4); background: radial-gradient(circle at 38% 34%, rgba(156, 255, 245, .42), rgba(30, 112, 110, .45) 65%, rgba(7, 30, 36, .5));
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(90, 240, 225, .2); transition: transform .06s linear;
  }
  .stick-arrows { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: .22; }
  .stick-arrows i { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; border: 5px solid transparent; }

## Objective
- Build a polished, playable Three.js third-person platformer in the existing workspace.
- Complete Stage 1 only: graphics pipeline, small test environment, and player controls; propose later stages and wait for the user’s OK before proceeding.

## Requirements
- Browser-ready with minimal setup, preferably `index.html` plus CDN imports.
- Stage 1 graphics should prioritize a lush, high-quality presentation and include a renderer pipeline and attractive test environment.
- Responsive controls: camera-relative movement, jump/double jump, dash, attack, wall/ledge mechanics, fixed-step physics, coyote time, and buffering; support keyboard/mouse, gamepad, and multitouch.
- Modular code; mark the placeholder character’s GLTF replacement point.
- Do not move on to later stages until the user says OK.
- User asked for screenshots to be saved as small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px) and only the latest screenshot read.

## Decisions
- Assistant chose a procedural, asset-free game named **Aetherbound — Shards of Dawn**, using Three.js CDN imports and locally generated visual/audio effects.
- Assistant began implementing much more than Stage 1, including four connected zones, enemies, bosses, combat, collectibles, UI, and audio; this exceeds the user’s stage boundary and should not be extended further without approval.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with UI styling/menus and import map for Three.js 0.160.0 CDN modules.
- Created modular JavaScript files for input, audio, environment/rendering, effects, world objects/props, multiple zones, and player controller/placeholder character.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 in tmux session `game`.

### Active
- Implementation is incomplete: inspect the repository state, identify missing modules/entry point, resolve errors, and get Stage 1 playable.
- Validate in browser, capture a latest small JPEG screenshot, and fix visual/runtime issues.
- Reconcile scope with Stage 1 boundary before adding anything further.

### Blocked
- No explicit blocker reported; no browser verification or test results were shown.

## Next Move
1. Inspect current files and git status; determine whether `js/main.js` and required imported modules exist and whether code parses.
2. Run the app and fix runtime/build issues until Stage 1 is playable and visually verified.
3. Save and inspect one latest screenshot per the user’s screenshot requirement.
4. Summarize assumptions and propose later stages without proceeding into them; await the user’s OK.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, UI, Three.js CDN import map, entry-point reference.
- `js/Environment.js`: Renderer, sky, lighting, fog, and post-processing.
- `js/Input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, gamepad, and multitouch input.
- `js/Player.js`: Player controller and procedural character; includes GLTF swap-point comment.
- `js/World.js`: World assembly and zone integration.
- `js/Utils.js`: Shared utilities and procedural textures.
- `js/Effects.js`: Particles and combat/camera effects.
- `js/Audio.js`: Procedural WebAudio.
- `js/world/`: Zone props, objects, and zone builders, including `meadow.js`, `ruins.js`, `crystal.js`, and `sky.js`.
- `screenshots/`: Created for screenshot checks.

## Important Context
- Assistant’s last visible action wrote `js/Player.js`; no completion message, test output, screenshot, or user approval followed.
- The transcript shows several large file writes with output truncated; verify actual file contents rather than assuming every module is complete.
- `index.html` references `./js/main.js`, but no write of `js/main.js` appears in the transcript.

Now the key task: write main.js. But there's a lot in scope: camera, combat (enemies missing entirely), gems, checkpoints, portals, gates, bosses, saving. Stage 1 only requires test environment + player controls. So main.js can:

- Boot Environment, World, Player, Effects, Audio, Input.
- Camera controller with orbit/mouse look, collision-free follow.
- Game loop with fixed-step player updates.
- Collect gems, checkpoints, portals? Stage 1 could include gems as goal, but portals lead to other zones (Stage 2+). To respect scope: gate the world to meadow; for testing, maybe allow free explore. Hmm, but World builds all four zones. That's heavy memory; but okay. Could add a way to only build meadow via option. Let's check size of the scene spawn and startup performance. Boot cost might be heavy but fine.

Better approach: Add constructor option `{ zones: ['meadow'] }` to World and skip building other zones. Then main.js uses only meadow. The remaining zone code stays for Stage 2. ## Process lifecycle

## Objective
- Build a polished, playable Three.js third-person platformer, completing Stage 1 only: rendering pipeline, test environment, and player controls.
- Verify Stage 1 in a browser, then propose later stages and wait for the user’s OK before proceeding.

## Requirements
- Browser-ready with minimal setup, preferably `index.html` plus CDN imports.
- Support camera-relative movement, jump/double jump, dash, attack, wall/ledge mechanics, fixed-step physics, coyote time, and input buffering; keyboard/mouse, gamepad, and multitouch.
- Keep code modular and mark the placeholder character’s GLTF replacement point.
- Save screenshots as small JPEGs at ≤1280px; read only the latest screenshot.
- Do not proceed to later stages without the user’s OK.

## Decisions
- The game is **Aetherbound — Shards of Dawn**, with procedural visuals/audio and Three.js CDN imports.
- `js/main.js` gates world construction to the meadow; ruins, crystal, sky, enemies, and bosses are not activated in Stage 1.
- The user has not approved any later stage.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `js/main.js` to wire renderer, input, world, player, effects, audio, HUD, menus, and the Stage 1 meadow.
- Added optional zone selection to `World`; Stage 1 constructs only the meadow.
- Fixed meadow lantern placement and player collider handling while standing on platforms.
- Added/adjusted pause UI, Stage 1 menu/objective text, quality preference handling, god-ray toggling, and character lighting.
- Ran JavaScript syntax checks and exercised browser startup, movement, jumping, dash, menus, and related interactions.
- Captured and inspected multiple JPEGs in `screenshots/`, including `screenshots/play3.jpg`.

### Active
- Finish browser verification after the latest code changes, address any runtime or visual issues, and capture/read one final latest JPEG at ≤1280px.
- Review final changes and report Stage 1 status plus proposed later stages.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect current git status and rerun syntax checks after the latest edits.
2. Reload the browser and verify Stage 1 startup and core controls without relying on test-only teleports; check console errors.
3. Capture a final JPEG at ≤1280px, then read only that latest screenshot.
4. Summarize completed Stage 1 work, list later stages as proposals, and wait for the user’s OK.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, menus/HUD, import map, and entry-point reference.
- `js/main.js`: Game boot, Stage 1 flow, UI, camera, and input callbacks.
- `js/Environment.js`: Renderer, lighting, post-processing, quality settings, and god rays.
- `js/World.js`: World assembly and zone selection.
- `js/Player.js`: Player controls, physics, placeholder character, and collider handling.
- `js/Input.js`: Keyboard, mouse, gamepad, and touch controls.
- `js/Effects.js`: Particles and camera/combat effects.
- `js/Audio.js`: Procedural audio.
- `js/Utils.js`: Shared utilities and procedural textures.
- `js/world/`: Zone builders, props, and world objects.
- `screenshots/`: Browser-validation JPEGs, including earlier captures.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push was reported.
- A local HTTP server was started on port 3002 using `/tmp/opencode/nocache_server.py`.
- Latest browser activity teleported the player out of bounds to test death/game-over behavior; confirm the page is returned to normal Stage 1 state before final capture.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
